bounded_complete_state.principle: The adapter stores complete state without exceeding the fixed archive bound.

complete_fixed_event_roster.principle: Every fixed event needs a terminal acknowledgment row.

corruption_sequence_and_queue_controls.principle: Corruption, repeated sequence, duplicate event, and overflow must fail closed.

installed_native_binding_executed.principle: A fixture cannot pass by replacing the installed PyO3 controller.

native_controller_parity.principle: Storage may change, but every native endpoint and event order must match.

persist_full_singleton_storage.principle: Read-back settings and row shape, not intent, define the storage contract.

seeded_crash_recovery.principle: Every acknowledged prefix must restore exactly once after real process death.

zero_missing_acknowledged_events.principle: No acknowledged event may disappear from durable state.

field_principles.MODEL_SPECS: Actual executable local model identities; keep historical models in hashed sidecars.
field_principles.acceptance_gate_results: Each check names expected, observed, passed and principle.
field_principles.baseline_validation_failures: Preserve non-gating failures from the explicitly requested repository-wide baseline run.
field_principles.completed_at_utc: Record the real UTC terminal decision time.
field_principles.crash_control_rows: Record kill point, acknowledged sequence, recovered prefix/hash and allowed suffix.
field_principles.duration_s: Measure monotonic elapsed time and disjoint phase spans, including initialization.
field_principles.execution_venue: Host is host; identify actual native execution separately.
field_principles.experiment_id: Bind the evidence to the fixed experiment task.
field_principles.field_principles: Store explanations here while consumer values remain ordinary top-level values.
field_principles.filesystem_receipt: Record mount, SQLite, VFS and actual sync traces with durability limits.
field_principles.gate_check_summary: Every blocked verdict names upstream, exact field, observed and expected value.
field_principles.honest_verdict: Complete findings start complete_; external absence starts blocked_.
field_principles.inference_substrate: Use the recognized literal for actual computation; never infer from intended work.
field_principles.inference_substrate_class: Use the actual no-LLM class and never pad elapsed time.
field_principles.invocation_counts: Separate attempted and completed loads and generation; retain failed counts.
field_principles.model_invoked: True for any actual attempted model load or generation, including failed and unusable work.
field_principles.native_identity: Bind installed module bytes, source/build identity and actual native calls.
field_principles.preconditions_checked: Hash actual inputs, authority boundaries, resource ownership and failed checks.
field_principles.random_seed: Freeze development and independent evaluation seeds before observing outcomes.
field_principles.reproducibility_checksum: Bind code, configuration, inputs, native identity and immutable raw evidence.
field_principles.rows: Keep every arm, event, seed, metric, cost, error, abstention and censoring result.
field_principles.run_date: Use 20260914, real UTC start/end and monotonic timing.
field_principles.sample_size_budget: Record planned, attempted, complete and censored units plus the frozen stopping rule.
field_principles.schema: Version the artifact; retain ordinary top-level experiment_id and milestone.
field_principles.snapshot_journal_ready_score: One requires real native calls, exact acknowledgment parity, recovery and controls.
field_principles.source_artifact_hashes: Keep exact producer identities, terminal classes, retirement and quarantine state.
field_principles.started_at_utc: Record the real UTC start of this invocation.
field_principles.status: Use a terminal complete or blocked record; unfinished own work belongs in separate checkpoints.
field_principles.storage_contract: Record one full row, effective PERSIST/FULL settings, initialization, acknowledgment and recovery.
field_principles.validation_receipts: Keep command, exit code, elapsed time and log hash; preserve actual failures.
field_principles.verdict_class: Use the closed class; oracle evidence forbids positive and failed gates forbid readiness.
field_principles.verifier_is_oracle: Expose shared verifier authority; same-authority mechanics are not learned correctness.

filesystem_receipt.durability_limit: SIGKILL tests cover process death, not power removal or storage firmware honesty.

sync_trace.comparison_scope: one initialized full-snapshot commit per host adapter
sync_trace.limitation: Observed process syscalls do not prove device firmware or physical power-loss behavior.

filesystem_receipt.vfs_effective_evidence: the database opened through an explicit vfs=unix URI

sample_size_budget.stopping_rule: Run three fixed group arms and five boundaries for four seeds once; do not expand after outcomes.
